5.0.0-beta.1.title: New Beta Available - 5.0.0-beta.9
5.0.0-beta.1.content:
CST Reader 5.0.0-beta.9 is available. Beta 9 brings Sanskrit letters (ś, ṣ, ṛ, ai, au and visarga) to every script, adds Odia as the fifteenth script, and lets the AI Assistant read selections of any length. Betas 6 to 8 added an AI Assistant you can ask about the text you are reading, which remembers your conversations, your choice of AI provider, first-class Windows support on x64 and ARM64, Find in Page, text zoom, a book font per script, and Digital Pāḷi Dictionary roots.

IMPORTANT: coming from Beta 4 or earlier, delete the contents of ~/Library/Application Support/CSTReader/ (Windows: %APPDATA%\CSTReader\) before installing. The search index format changed in Beta 5 and an older index will not be read correctly.

announcements.title: CST Reader Beta 9 Released
